actual_read_scope: All four fresh EuropePMC abstracts and Crossref identities checked. Biomethanation and tobacco complete main-body XML texts read including methods,results,discussion,table text and captions. No original figure pixels,separate supplementary files,raw data or analysis code audited. Figure alt text is not independent experimental evidence.

Arsenic and compost changes are abstract-bounded. Neither EuropePMC metadata exposed a PMC article; DOI searches found publisher pages whose opens returned403. No exhaustive full-text absence claim,access bypass or author contact. Existing caches retained; no article-body import. Tobacco source license is CC BY-NC-ND4.0,not unrestricted CC BY.

Arsenic retains direct NanoSIMS carbon transfer and reciprocal-growth mutualism. Supplemented heterotroph culture and genomic complementarity do not independently establish oxygen-source necessity,nitrogen transfer or the identity of exchanged carbon compounds. Existing culture-conditions discussion remains open.

Biomethanation preserves measured methane and VFA outcomes from a single sequential CSTR. External gas supply is not microbial cross-feeding. Taxon-specific routes and thermodynamic cooperation remain interpretations; qPCR counts are not activity or viability. Washout affects pools,phase1sampling wording is not assigned to phase4. Non-graph roles/viability claims remain1935.

Compost retains reported maturation,transient ARG rebound and later attenuation. KEGG and potential host-gene networks are not expression,actual motility or transfer-frequency measurements. Maturation-to-attenuation remains PARTIAL; no maturation-to-profile causation is inferred from shared inoculation. Non-graph overview/role/access wording remains1936.

Tobacco keeps positive strain-specific broth and combined field-treatment results,including the Y878 null enhancement. cheA positivity is potential,not measured root migration; authors call for non-chemotactic controls. Source species/strain rows,resource-count discrepancies and tomato caption wording remain1937. The graph does not certify the current merged two-row taxonomy.
